findings.subject: Release pipeline (.github/workflows/release-beta.yml, scripts/design-system/publish-beta.mjs, .changeset)
findings.summary: Every beta publish since 2026-11-18 fails at the 'latest' dist-tag step, so npm 'latest' lags 'beta' on all 8 packages, release tags and registry evidence are never recorded, and README's promise that a plain install gets the beta is false.
findings.evidence: gh run view 44371320697 --log-failed: 'npm error 403 ... PUT .../@atom63%2fstyles/dist-tags/latest - This trusted publisher cannot manage dist-tags. Ask a package maintainer to enable Allow npm dist-tag.' Publish job failed in runs 44206565829, 44221661319, 44221720585, 44231752616, 44371320697; record-evidence skipped in all. npm view dist-tags: styles latest 0.1.0-beta.5/beta 0.1.0-beta.8, ui-foundation 0.1.1-beta.2/0.2.0-beta.5, ui-react 0.2.0-beta.9/0.2.0-beta.12, mdx 0.4.0-beta.0/0.4.0-beta.3, inform 0.2.0-beta.0/0.2.0-beta.3, agent 0.3.0-beta.0/0.3.0-beta.1, widgets 0.1.0-beta.0/0.1.0-beta.3, cli 0.1.0-beta.0/0.1.0-beta.1. README.md:15-17 says latest follows beta; packages/agent/README.md:7, packages/inform/README.md:6, packages/widgets/README.md:7, packages/ui-foundation/README.md:23 install without @beta. Remote git tags stop at @atom63/ui-react@0.2.0-beta.11. Manual dispatch 44376792409 exits at release-beta.yml:78-81 because nothing is unpublished. docs/design-system/release-automation.md:42 documents the needed setting.
findings.fix: Enable 'Allow npm dist-tag' on each of the 8 trusted publishers (maintainer action on npmjs.com), then let a dispatch run move latest: allow workflow_dispatch to run the dist-tag loop when nothing is unpublished (release-beta.yml:78-81), and make publish-beta.mjs report a dist-tag failure separately so record-evidence still tags the published versions.

verified.reason: Reproduced. The gh log for run 44371320697 shows E403 'This trusted publisher cannot manage dist-tags' on PUT .../@atom63%2fstyles/dist-tags/latest. npm view shows latest behind beta (styles 0.1.0-beta.5 vs beta.8, ui-react beta.9 vs beta.12, mdx beta.0 vs beta.3, cli beta.0 vs beta.1). README.md:15-17 promises that latest follows beta. Runs 44371320697, 44231752616 and 44221720585 failed, and dispatch 44376792409 failed too. The later push runs pass only because nothing is left to publish. release-automation.md documents the 'Allow npm dist-tag' setting but nobody has applied it, so the promise is broken. Root cause fixed 2026-11-18: all 8 trusted publishers now allow dist-tags; release-beta runs 44387150352 and 44408576633 succeeded. latest still lags beta until the next real publish. Downgraded by Claude.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: Stability tiers contradict each other: contracts and the CLI call 69 of 76 components 'stable' while the package's own stable action matrix says 30 families, including Dialog, Select and Tooltip, must not promise stable compatibility, and 31 preview-tier symbols still ship from the root entry.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/dialog.json:4, select.json:4, tooltip.json:4: "maturity": "stable"; `pnpm -s atom63 component dialog` -> '**Status:** Stable'; agent-index.json maturity counts {stable: 69, preview: 7}. docs/design-system/audits/ui-react-stable-action-matrix.json summary.sourcePriorityCounts P0: 30, e.g. components/dialog recommendedAction 'move-to-preview-or-approve', stableDecision 'Move behind preview/experimental boundary, make private, or explicitly approve support before stable/latest.' ui-react-export-inventory.json: 31 root exports tagged preview-experimental-candidate (DialogPrimitive, DialogCreateHandle, TooltipPrimitive, InputPrimitive, cardLinkClassName, ...) and tierPolicy.stableBlockers unmet. packages/ui-react/api/ui-react.api.md has 0 @beta/@alpha/@experimental tags (every symbol '// @public').
findings.fix: Pick one source of truth: derive contract maturity from the export tier (a family is 'stable' only when no export is preview-experimental or monitor-high-risk without evidence), move the 31 preview symbols to ./preview or approve them in the decision register, and emit the tier as a TSDoc release tag so the API report shows it. Cross-check with layer 2 criterion C5.

verified.reason: Partly true. dialog/select/tooltip contracts do say maturity 'stable', and ui-react.api.md has 0 @beta/@alpha/@experimental tags. But the claim that Dialog itself 'must not promise stable compatibility' is overstated. The matrix flags only 2 of the Dialog family's 19 exports (DialogPrimitive, DialogCreateHandle), and 17 are beta-supported-core. Its promotionDecision is also a documented choice: 'keep-beta-root-unchanged-preview-only', status 'preview-only-pending-root-removal-before-stable'. So the component maturity labels and the stable-blocker list for low-level aliases do not truly contradict each other. What remains is a gap in labeling and in tier tags: preview aliases ship from the root with no tags. That gap blocks a stable release, not the beta's 'ready'.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The bundle budget is a ratchet with 0.3 kB headroom that has been raised 14 times, and it sums every entry instead of measuring what a consumer pays per import, so it never proves tree-shaking.
findings.evidence: scratchpad/sweep/ui-react-size.log: '97.7 kB gzip / 98 kB budget'; scripts/design-system/check-ui-react-bundle-size.mjs:8-108 records raises 64 -> 72 -> 74 -> 76 -> 82 -> 84 -> 86 -> 87 -> 88 -> 91 -> 92 -> 93 -> 94 -> 95 -> 96 -> 97 -> 98 kB; :109 'const gzipBudgetBytes = 98 * 1024' over all dist .js files. Registry consumer importing only Card, Badge, Input, Button builds 344.84 kB / 107.52 kB gzip JS (scratchpad/sweep/ds-registry-smoke.log), i.e. ~50 kB gzip beyond React 19 for four components.
findings.fix: Add per-entry budgets plus an import-cost check (bundle a fixture that imports one component, e.g. Button, from the root and assert its gzip size), and keep a fixed headroom rule instead of raising the cap when a change lands.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The ui-react root entry imports react-hook-form, a required peer, so every consumer must install it and evaluates it on any root import, even without Form.
findings.evidence: grep "from 'react-hook-form'" packages/ui-react/dist -> dist/index.js; packages/ui-react/package.json:177 peer 'react-hook-form': '^7.81.0' with no peerDependenciesMeta; scripts/design-system/check-ui-react-root-deps.mjs:23 guards only react-day-picker, the same problem that moved Calendar to ./calendar.
findings.fix: Move Form to a ./form subpath (like ./calendar), mark react-hook-form optional in peerDependenciesMeta, and add it to subpathOnlyDependencies in check-ui-react-root-deps.mjs.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The build strips every 'use client' directive: 87 ui-react source files and 7 mdx files declare it, and no built .js file keeps it, so React Server Component consumers get no client boundary.
findings.evidence: grep -rl 'use client' packages/ui-react/src | wc -l -> 87 (e.g. packages/ui-react/src/provider.tsx:1, components/tabs/tabs.tsx:1); grep -rl 'use client' packages/ui-react/dist packages/mdx/dist | grep .js -> 0; scratchpad/sweep/build.log:98 'Module level directives cause errors when bundled, "use client" in "dist/media/media-lightbox/parts/index.js" was ignored.'; tsup.config: treeshake true, no banner.
findings.fix: Either preserve directives (tsup banner {js: "'use client'"} per client entry, or an esbuild plugin that keeps per-file directives) and add a dist check that each entry starts with it, or delete the source directives and document that RSC is unsupported.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: mdx, inform and widgets depend on @atom63/ui-react as an exact-pinned regular dependency, so any version skew installs a second copy of ui-react with its own React contexts.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/package.json:101, packages/inform/package.json:64, packages/widgets/package.json:68: "@atom63/ui-react": "workspace:*"; published as exact pins: npm view @atom63/widgets@latest dependencies -> '@atom63/ui-react':'0.2.0-beta.9', @beta -> '0.2.0-beta.12'. With latest stale (finding 1), `pnpm add @atom63/widgets @atom63/ui-react@beta` resolves two copies; UIEnvironmentContext (packages/ui-react/src/provider.tsx:20) then does not reach the nested copy. dependency-version-policy.json allows workspace deps during beta only as 'exact-published-before-stable', and has no rule against duplication.
findings.fix: Make @atom63/ui-react (and @atom63/styles for mdx) a peerDependency with a caret beta range in mdx, inform and widgets, keep it as a devDependency, and add a dependency-policy rule that internal UI packages are peers.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-foundation
findings.summary: ui-foundation has an API report but no tier inventory, and 1444 of its reported declarations are undocumented.
findings.fix: Extend the export inventory to ui-foundation's exports and document the contract objects consumers import directly (e.g. buttonContract used by the registry smoke).

findings.subject: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, visual.yml, ios-snapshots.yml)
findings.summary: CI still carries a live known flake and two non-hermetic jobs: the WebKit sign-in story fails intermittently, the packed and registry smoke tests break on upstream releases and live npm state, and 26 of 40 Dependabot CI runs fail.
findings.evidence: gh run view 40566990028 (main, 2026-10-27) and 44203452194 (PR, 2026-11-17): 'FAIL cross-browser (webkit) ../../packages/templates/src/pages/sign-in-page/sign-in-page.stories.tsx > Wrong Password'; story at sign-in-page.stories.tsx:38; no retries configured anywhere (git grep retries). Lightbox focus flake: not seen in the last 200 CI runs. Packed smoke 'pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile' online fallback (scripts/design-system/smoke-packed-ui-react.mjs:399-411) failed 8 runs, e.g. 44156374624 'framer-motion ... error TS2320'. Registry smoke failed 4 runs (e.g. 44218177744 'registry-only consumer smoke failed' after a clean build); release-beta.yml:243-245 says a publish makes the evidence stale and 'fails every later CI run until someone regenerates it'. Dependabot branches: 3 success / 26 failure / 10 cancelled of 40; 8 fail at 'Check dependency version policy'.
findings.fix: Fix the WebKit sign-in story's race (await the error state, not a timer) or quarantine it with a tracked issue; give the smoke consumers a committed lockfile so upstream releases cannot break PRs; run the live-registry smoke only on main/schedule rather than on every PR; have Dependabot PRs regenerate dependency-version-policy.json (a workflow step or a release:version-style script).

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-ios (Atom63UI Swift package)
findings.summary: ui-ios has a root manifest for remote SwiftPM consumers but no release path: it is private, stuck at 0.1.0 with 8 pending minor changesets, and the repo has no SemVer tags SwiftPM can resolve.
findings.evidence: Package.swift:3-5 'Distribution manifest for remote SwiftPM consumers'; packages/ui-ios/package.json private:true, version 0.1.0; .changeset/ios-*.md (8 files, '@atom63/ui-ios': minor); git ls-remote --tags origin shows only @atom63/<pkg>@<version> tags; packages/ui-ios/README.md:9 'Add a local Swift package dependency pointing at packages/ui-ios'.
findings.fix: YZ decides whether Atom63UI is a released product. If yes: tag SemVer releases (e.g. ui-ios-v0.2.0 is not resolvable; SwiftPM needs plain 0.2.0 tags or a separate repo) from the Version Packages flow and add a remote-resolution smoke. If no: drop the remote-consumer claim from Package.swift and stop versioning it with changesets.

findings.subject: All packages
findings.summary: Dependency direction and cycles hold today but no check enforces them; check:package-correctness, named in the bar, only runs publint and attw.
findings.evidence: scripts/design-system/check-package-correctness.mjs:1-8 (publint + attw on packed tarballs). Manual graph: styles, ui-foundation, agent, cli -> none; ui-react -> styles, ui-foundation; mdx -> styles, ui-react; inform, widgets -> ui-react; templates -> ui-foundation, ui-react; create -> cli. scratchpad cycles.mjs (Tarjan SCC over non-test relative runtime imports): 0 cycles in ui-react(249 files), ui-foundation(173), mdx(119), widgets(35), inform(30), agent(9).
findings.fix: Add a check (dependency-cruiser rules or a small script over package.json + source imports) that fails on upward imports (e.g. ui-foundation importing ui-react), deep imports past exports, and runtime cycles.

findings.subject: @atom63/cli
findings.summary: @atom63/cli exports a library entry with no type declarations, so attw skips it and TypeScript consumers of '@atom63/cli' get implicit any.
findings.evidence: packages/cli/package.json exports {'.': './src/core.mjs', './agents-md': './src/agents-md.mjs'} with no 'types'; check-package-correctness.mjs:33-36 only checks exports that declare types; no sideEffects field.
findings.fix: Ship .d.ts (JSDoc + tsc --emitDeclarationOnly) for the two library exports, or drop them from exports if only the bin is public.

findings.subject: @atom63/ui-react
findings.summary: The ui-react API reports tolerate four ae-forgotten-export warnings: public signatures reference types consumers cannot import.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/api/ui-react.api.md:673 UseCarouselParameters, :1376 feedbackIcons; ui-react.theme.api.md:57 Button; ui-react.media-lightbox.api.md:104 DestinationLink.
findings.fix: Export those types from their entries (or inline them), and make api-report.mjs --check fail on ae-forgotten-export.
